summary: Comprehensive Implementation Plan for an extensive Crop & Plant Disease Library covering all common diseases across major staple, cash, and horticultural crops (Cassava, Maize, Beans, Tomato, Sweet Potato, Coffee, Avocado, Sukuma Wiki, Mango, Pigeon Peas) with bilingual Kiswahili/English guidance, visual symptom recognition, organic & chemical treatment protocols, direct case reporting integration, and admin/officer publishing capabilities.
